home.missionText: Many students don’t get consistent access to hands-on STEM resources. We close that gap with practical robotics learning that turns curiosity into skills—and skills into confidence.
home.aboutBlurbText: Rise is a student-led nonprofit initiative bringing robotics education to young learners at the GRACE Academic Center in Kisii, Kenya, in collaboration with the nonprofit organization TEEEM.

partnerBanner.text: Partnered with GRACE Academic Center (Kisii, Kenya).

about.title: About us
paragraphs: Rise is a student-led nonprofit initiative bringing robotics education to young learners at the GRACE Academic Center in Kisii, Kenya, in collaboration with the nonprofit organization TEEEM. We’ve raised about $6,000 to provide VEX-IQ kits sufficient for 50 students, with 30 students currently actively participating in the program.

Our mission is to create a sustainable robotics curriculum that teaches elementary and middle schoolers fundamental building and coding concepts, empowering them with skills for the future. Over the summer, our team of student volunteers conducted regular Zoom training sessions with GRACE teachers, developed an eight-week curriculum with instructional videos, and built a custom website to support long-term learning.
The GRACE Academic Center is a co-ed day school serving around 120 students, known for its commitment to high-quality education and support for disadvantaged children.
